contextEvidenceLimit: Retain optional providerPromptEvaluation exactly. Reported count is a provider assertion, not proof of full context processing, attention, tokenizer fit or prose accuracy; no ratio or character-to-token estimate.

hostAdmission.scope: One fresh passive pre-launch host memory admission: normal pressure level1 and free percentage at least35. No polling or retry. Failure leaves this episode unexecuted before service/readiness/session/generation.

endpoint: Must be supplied from newly qualified owned listener; never a default endpoint.
serviceStartLimit: Require at least1140seconds remaining before Start:900seconds active cap+180seconds for an already dispatched generation+60seconds margin. If insufficient do not Start; no extension/replacement.
qualityVerdict: No automatic scientific or creative-quality pass. Read every response including incomplete outcomes and distinguish saving/application from interpretation.
comparisonLimit: Known previous v4 twelve-entry episode is descriptive reference, not an unseen control. One dependent sequence cannot establish causality, emergence or general quality.
priorObservationLimit: previousMeasurements refers to the previous reached observation, independently of the previous saved/applied full-text journal. Two endpoints establish net change only.
authorizationScope: User asks to continue the writing-environment tranche after the qualified v5 refinement; one bounded owned local-model episode and complete review.
stopRules: First session boundary:361steps,12attempts,900active seconds or64MiB. In-flight request may settle within its180second deadline beyond active cap.
Incomplete, rejected or failed generation: retain and end episode; no Skip or Retry.
Any save failure: preserve recoverable evidence, end model episode; no further generation.
Model supervisor expires1200seconds after spawn. No service replacement.
writingContext: Compact optional RMS, sensory fill and coordinate-distance readings; exact latest eligible journal near final invitation. Full observation v2 remains in evidence.
startWitness: Record UTC immediately before and after the native Start click; both endpoints must retain at least1140seconds of the1200second owned-service lifetime. Monotonic parent check precedes click. Preserve a deviation; never replace the episode.
